integrity.description: The agent did not hardcode the 'Portsmouth' world model without checking the files.
integrity.visual_evidence: The agent's command history shows it opening environment.ini to find the 'Setting' value.

privileged_info_for_vlm: Bridge Command INI files use a specific format: text values are enclosed in quotes (e.g., Setting="Portsmouth", ShipName="Voyager") while numerical values are not (e.g., StartTime=14.0). In othership.ini, traffic vessels are indexed as Type(1), Type(2), etc. A scenario is 'complete' only if environment.ini, ownship.ini, and othership.ini all exist in the directory. Checksums must use absolute paths as per the standard sha256sum format.
